definitions.gloss: inside an aircraft; in-flight; onboard (an airplane)
definitions.explanation: The interior of an airplane. Used as a modifier to describe services, food, entertainment, and other things available during a flight.

examples.japanese: {機内|きない}では{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}の{電源|でんげん}をお{切|き}りください。
examples.english: Please turn off your mobile phone inside the aircraft.

examples.japanese: {機内|きない}{食|しょく}はあまりおいしくなかった。
examples.english: The in-flight meal wasn't very good.

examples.japanese: {機内|きない}アナウンスが{日本語|にほんご}と{英語|えいご}で{流|なが}れた。
examples.english: The in-flight announcement was made in both Japanese and English.

notes:
{機内|きない} means inside an aircraft. The {機|き} refers to {飛行機|ひこうき} (airplane). Used primarily as a modifier for in-flight services and items.

COMPOSITION:
{機|き} (machine, aircraft) + {内|ない} (inside).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {機内|きない}{食|しょく}: in-flight meal
- {機内|きない}{誌|し}: in-flight magazine
- {機内|きない}{持|も}ち{込|こ}み: carry-on (luggage)
- {機内|きない}エンターテインメント: in-flight entertainment
- {機内|きない}アナウンス: in-flight announcement
- {機内|きない}Wi-Fi: onboard Wi-Fi

SIMILAR 〜{内|ない} LOCATION WORDS:
- {車内|しゃない}: inside a vehicle/train
- {室内|しつない}: indoors, inside a room
- {店内|てんない}: inside a store
